title: Dutch John Resort

services.name: Raft Guides
services.desc: Some river days are about the rapids. A great day of rafting at Flaming Gorge in summer is about something better: clear cold water, glowing red canyon walls, and a string of sandy beaches made for pulling over, spreading out lunch, and swimming until you are ready to drift again. The stretch of the Green River below Flaming Gorge Dam is one of the few places in Utah where you can plan an entire float around where you want to stop and cool off. A day of green river rafting here is less about conquering water and more about savoring it, and this guide shows you how to build your Green River day around the best swimming sand bars. The magic starts at the base of the Flaming Gorge Dam. The dam
